title: 第23章 河伯村河灵第24章 下迷药
content_zh:
虎蜥，体型巨大，身子像蜥蜴，脑袋似老虎，头上还顶着一个“主”字。
童青山和张楚看到它的时候，它也看到了童青山。
当张楚和童青山逼近虎蜥，想要进攻的时候，却发现这虎蜥竟然不断的后退，眼神中充满了忌惮。
并且，它的行动稍稍有些缓慢，好像是受了伤。
“嗯？这畜生有点意思，竟然知道害怕！”童青山说道。
张楚则忽然说道：“等等，先别动手。”
“怎么了？”童青山问道。
此时张楚指了指不远处，那里竟然有半截没烧完的熏香。
“这是什么？”童青山不解。
张楚低声道：“看来，这虎蜥是别人的猎物，人家已经下手了。”
张楚在《大荒经》中看到过，这熏香名叫淞香，是一种生活在河里的植物果实。
把它点燃之后，对蜥蜴类的生灵，有非常大的吸引力，它们会不自觉的吸收这东西的味道。
但是，这东西却对蜥蜴类的生灵有害，连续吸食十二天，妖王境界之下的蜥蜴，都会任人宰割。
张楚对《大荒经》内的内容过目不忘，自然认出了这东西。
果然，此时一个中年人不知道从哪里钻了出来，低声喊道：“二位，别惊扰了这虎蜥！”
张楚和童青山扭头，这是一个看起来很普通的村民。
于是张楚问道：“它是你们的猎物？”
那村民说道：“没错，为了逮这个东西，我们已经准备了七八天，村里有好几个小伙子都折在了它手上，这东西可不好惹。”
童青山笑了：“不好惹么？”
村民则低声道：“两位，我好心提醒你们，千万别惹怒了它，它的劲儿大的很，现在这淞香才燃了六天，还不是动它的时候。”

这村民看起来和善可亲，并没有对张楚和童青山恶语相向，童青山顿时对他有了些好感。
于是童青山说道：“这样，我帮你们杀了这虎蜥，尸体你们拿走，我们只是想住在虎蜥的窝里。”
村民一听，顿时摆手：“那怎么行！杀这个太危险了，你们不是它的对手……”
不等村民的话说完，童青山便提着枪冲了出去。
那虎蜥见到退无可退，顿时凶性爆发，朝着童青山冲了过来，想拼命。
但它哪里是童青山的对手。
开辟了十二洞命井的童青山，根本就不是普通的妖物能抵挡，仅一个回合，童青山的枪便洞穿了虎蜥的眉心。
轰隆，虎蜥巨大的身体摔在地上，死了。
“嘶……”那村民见状，顿时倒吸了一口冷气：“你们这么厉害！”
童青山收了枪，淡淡的说道：“一只大蜥蜴而已，你们快喊村民，把它的尸体运走吧！”
这村民答应了一声，急忙回村，去喊同伴。
几分钟之后，几十个村民呼啦啦赶了过来。
让张楚和童青山惊讶的是，这支猎人队的队长，竟然是一个女子，仔细看，那女子还挺漂亮。
“真是奇怪……”张楚心中嘀咕。
倒不是说，女子不能进入猎人队，而是她化的妆，太怪了。
她脸上，额头上都涂着厚厚的腮红，嘴唇也抹的鲜红，脸上的其他部位，则雪白如纸。
看起来，仿佛是那种准备结冥婚的女人。
而且，这女子一身的衣服鲜红，看起来有一种不伦不类的喜庆感。
隔着很远，小葡萄就忍不住靠紧了张楚：“先生，那个女人好可怕！”
content_en:
The tiger lizard is huge in size, with a body like a lizard and a head like a tiger, with the word "lord" on its head.
When Tong Qingshan and Zhang Chu saw it, it also saw Tong Qingshan.
When Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan approached the tiger lizard and wanted to attack, they found that the tiger lizard kept retreating, with fear in their eyes.
Moreover, it moved a little slowly, as if it was injured.
"Huh? This beast is interesting, he actually knows how to be afraid!" Tong Qingshan said.
Zhang Chuze suddenly said: "Wait, don't do anything yet."
"What's wrong?" Tong Qingshan asked.
At this time, Zhang Chu pointed not far away, where there was half-burned incense.
"What is this?" Tong Qingshan was confused.
Zhang Chu whispered: "It seems that this tiger lizard is someone else's prey, and they have already taken action."
Zhang Chu had read in the "Great Wilderness Sutra" that the incense was called Songxiang, and it was a plant fruit that lived in the river.
After lighting it, it will be very attractive to lizards, and they will absorb the smell of it unconsciously.
However, this thing is harmful to lizards. If it is consumed for twelve consecutive days, lizards below the level of the Demon King will be slaughtered by others.
Zhang Chu had a photographic memory of the contents of the Great Wilderness Scripture, so he naturally recognized this thing.
Sure enough, at this time, a middle-aged man emerged from nowhere and shouted in a low voice: "You two, don't disturb this tiger lizard!"
Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan turned their heads. This was an ordinary-looking villager.
So Zhang Chu asked: "Is it your prey?"
The villager said: "Yes, we have been preparing for seven or eight days to catch this thing. Several young men in the village fell into its hands. This thing is not easy to mess with."
Tong Qingshan smiled: "Isn't it difficult to provoke?"
The villager whispered: "You two, I kindly remind you not to anger it. It is very energetic. The incense has only been burning for six days, so it is not the time to touch it."
This villager seemed kind and amiable, and did not say anything bad to Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan. Tong Qingshan suddenly felt a little fond of him.
So Tong Qingshan said: "In this case, I will help you kill this tiger lizard, and you take the body. We just want to live in the tiger lizard's nest."
When the villagers heard this, they immediately waved their hands: "How can that be done! It's too dangerous to kill this one. You are no match for it..."
Before the villagers could finish speaking, Tong Qingshan rushed out with a gun.
Seeing that there was no way to retreat, the tiger lizard immediately exploded with ferocity and rushed towards Tong Qingshan, trying to fight for his life.
But it is no match for Tong Qingshan.
Tong Qingshan, who had opened twelve wells of life, was not something that ordinary monsters could resist. In just one round, Tong Qingshan's spear pierced the tiger lizard's eyebrows.
With a bang, the tiger lizard's huge body fell to the ground, dead.
"Hiss..." When the villager saw this, he suddenly took a breath of air: "You are so powerful!"
Tong Qingshan put away his gun and said calmly: "It's just a big lizard. Please call the villagers and take away its body!"
The villager agreed and hurried back to the village to call his companions.
A few minutes later, dozens of villagers rushed over shouting.
What surprised Zhang Chu and Tong Qingshan was that the leader of this hunter team was actually a woman. If you look closely, you can see that the woman is quite beautiful.
"It's really strange..." Zhang Chu muttered in his heart.
It's not that women can't join the hunter team, but the makeup she wears is too weird.
Her face and forehead were covered with thick blush, her lips were also painted bright red, and the rest of her face was as white as paper.
She looks like the kind of woman who is preparing to get married.
Moreover, this woman's clothes were bright red and she looked nondescript and festive.
Even though they were far away, Little Putao couldn't help but get closer to Zhang Chu: "Sir, that woman is so scary!"
